planos.imagem: a shiny black luxury SUV parking in front of a small cozy neighborhood bakery cafe with warm lights, Brazilian street, late afternoon
planos.movimento: the black SUV slowly pulls up and stops in front of the cafe, camera static
planos.sfx: car engine idling, tires on asphalt, street ambience

planos.imagem: wide shot, a rich arrogant couple entering a small simple bakery cafe through a glass door, looking around with disdain
planos.movimento: the couple walks in through the door, the woman takes off her sunglasses and looks around disgusted
planos.sfx: door bell chime, footsteps, cafe ambience

planos.texto: Olha só, esse lugar aqui só tem pé-rapado, né?
planos.imagem: medium close-up of the arrogant woman inside a simple cafe, wrinkling her nose with disgust, warm light

planos.texto: Amor, foi você que quis parar aqui. Eu falei pra gente ir no shopping.
planos.imagem: medium close-up of the smug man in a navy blazer inside a simple cafe, smirking, warm light
behind the counter of a cozy bakery cafe, a calm man in a beige apron drying a coffee cup, espresso machine behind him
planos.movimento: the man stops drying the cup and slowly looks up towards the door
planos.sfx: cup and cloth, espresso machine hiss, quiet cafe ambience

planos.texto: Não acredito. Lucas? Você ainda tá aqui servindo café?
planos.imagem: close-up of the arrogant woman recognizing someone, eyebrows raised, mocking half smile, cafe background blurred

planos.texto: Oi, Vanessa. Quanto tempo. O que vocês vão querer?
planos.imagem: close-up of the calm man in a beige apron behind the cafe counter, serene polite expression, warm light

planos.texto: Então esse é o ex que você largou? Fez bem, amor. Olha o avental dele.
planos.imagem: close-up of the smug man pointing with his chin, laughing condescendingly, cafe background blurred

planos.texto: Eu te falei. Ele nunca ia passar de balconista.
planos.imagem: close-up of the arrogant woman laughing cruelly, hand on her chest, gold jewelry, warm light
an older woman with grey curly hair sitting at a small cafe table with a cup of coffee, watching the scene with a disapproving frown
planos.movimento: the older woman slowly lowers her coffee cup and shakes her head in disapproval
planos.sfx: cup on saucer, quiet cafe ambience

planos.imagem: close-up of the calm man in a beige apron looking down at his smartphone on the counter, the screen glowing, a subtle knowing smile
planos.movimento: the man glances at a message on his phone, then looks up with a subtle confident smile
